source_edits.subject: name U+00A0 nonbreakingspace, as the release does
source_edits.body: FontLab's export named the glyph of U+00A0 with its Macintosh standard name, nonbreakingspace (post format 2, index 172); the .vfb names it nbspace. Same outline and advance; this renames the glyph as the release names it (tools/probes/upstream_main_2026-11-19/renames-layerfix-7ed09143.txt).

source_edits.subject: state the release's fsType 0
source_edits.body: The .vfb states fsType 4 (preview and print embedding). Google Fonts set it to 0 (installable) in google/fonts 8ccda7bf7 (2015-08-05, "Fix fsType for 40 font files"); the release ships 0. This states 0.
